purpose.domain_detail: University algorithms course (algo4/algoIIII) practical work (TP) involving multi-file merge of branch/teacher/class-type records with printed report
purpose.summary: A batch COBOL program that reads four sequential input files (three branch files and a times file) plus master tables for branches and class types, merges them by teacher number and date using a multi-file minimum-key algorithm, accumulates totals by date and teacher, and writes a formatted printed report with subtotals and grand totals. It is a student practical assignment (TP) for an algorithms course.

notable_features: Multi-file sequential merge with manual minimum-key selection across 4 files
OCCURS with ASCENDING KEY and INDEXED BY for in-memory lookup tables
VALUE OF FILE-ID for hardcoded file paths (GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL style)
Elaborate print-line record layouts for formatted reports
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
